ideas.name: MowerMate blade and skid-plate service kits
ideas.concept: Branded replacement blade sets (stainless, tuned to Husqvarna/Gardena/Worx/Segway-style mowers) plus a skid-plate and wheel-cleaning brush in a subscription-style yearly kit.
ideas.target_customer: Robot-mower owners in SE/DK with gardens
ideas.problem_solved: Blades dull in 4-8 weeks; OEM blades are pricey and hard to find.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (credits/search budget exhausted). Based on general knowledge that robot-mower adoption in Nordics keeps rising; no links verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand + exact-fit compatibility database + yearly reminder subscription; OEM compatibility must be checked (design-around risk).

ideas.name: Mower garage clip-on weather cover
ideas.concept: Slim UV and rain cover for robot mowers with ventilation and a docking-station cut-out, in designed Scandinavian colours.
ideas.target_customer: Robot mower owners without a garage
ideas.problem_solved: Sun, rain, snow and bird droppings degrade the mower and station.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible this run; demand inferred from mower adoption, not confirmed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design patent/registered design for the vented shape; fit per top 5 models.
ideas.tooling_needed: Cut-and-sew or vacuum-formed PP; low tooling (<EUR 1k)

ideas.name: Pool robot filter-basket refills
ideas.concept: Fine-mesh reusable and disposable filter baskets/cartridges for popular pool robots (Maytronics, Aiper, Wybotics) sold as 2-3 pack.
ideas.target_customer: Pool owners in DK/SE and wider EU via Amazon
ideas.problem_solved: Filters clog and OEM replacements are expensive.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no verified sources; cordless pool robots are widely reported growing but I could not confirm in this run.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak: copyable by Amazon sellers; edge only via finer mesh spec, testing and brand.
ideas.tooling_needed: Existing mesh/plastic parts; possible small mould

ideas.name: Muddy-paw station: absorbent doormat plus paw rinse cup
ideas.concept: Design-led diatomite/microfibre entry mat bundled with a silicone paw washer cup, sold as a Nordic mudroom set.
ideas.problem_solved: Mud and sand tracked indoors after walks.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: search unavailable; paw washers exist widely (likely crowded), so trend stage is uncertain.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design/bundle and brand; weak against lookalikes.
ideas.tooling_needed: Silicone mould for cup (low) and woven mat

ideas.name: Dog-walk gear wash: enzyme paw and coat wipes refill tin
ideas.concept: Reusable tin with compostable, pH-balanced wipes and refill pouches for post-walk paw/coat/car-seat cleaning.
ideas.problem_solved: Quick clean after walks without a bath.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no sources fetched; repeat-purchase logic only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own formulation (cosmetic/biocide regulation applies, needs EU safety assessment), refill ecosystem.

ideas.name: Concentrate car-wash pods (rinseless wash)
ideas.concept: Water-soluble rinseless/waterless wash pods in a tin: one pod per 8 L bucket, with microfibre cloth bundle.
ideas.problem_solved: Washing cars with little water where hose washing is restricted.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: search unavailable; detailing consumables are known to be popular but also crowded by established brands.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Pod format and design-led brand; formulation by contract blender; CLP/REACH labelling needed.

ideas.name: Garden-robot docking mat and drainage base
ideas.concept: Heavy-duty recycled-rubber/composite base plate for mower and pool-robot charging docks that prevents sinking, mud and wheel slip.
ideas.problem_solved: Docking failures from mud, grass growth and tilted stations.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: based on common owner forum complaints I could not link in this run.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design, universal fit pattern across brands; relatively unflooded niche.
